title: Version 0.12.0 cannot be resolved although Android Studio recommends upgrading to it
body:
Description

  Android Studio is suggesting an upgrade from 0.11.0 to 0.12.0 for com.mohamedrejeb.calf:calf-file-picker, but Gradle fails to resolve the 0.12.0 artifact. It appears that this version has not actually been published to Maven
  Central (or the corresponding repository), even though it is being advertised as available.

  Current behavior

  - Android Studio shows an inspection/lint suggestion to upgrade calf-file-picker to 0.12.0.
  - After bumping the version to 0.12.0 in libs.versions.toml, Gradle sync fails with a "Could not find" / unresolved dependency error.
  - Reverting to 0.11.0 works as expected.

  Expected behavior

  Either:
  - 0.12.0 should be published to the appropriate Maven repository so it can be resolved, or
  - The version should not be advertised as the latest available until it is actually published.

  Environment

  - Library: com.mohamedrejeb.calf:calf-file-picker
  - Current working version: 0.11.0
  - Suggested version (not resolvable): 0.12.0
  - IDE: Android Studio
  - Build system: Gradle with Version Catalog (libs.versions.toml)
  - Project type: Kotlin Multiplatform (Android + iOS) with Compose Multiplatform

  Additional notes

  Could you confirm whether 0.12.0 is intended to be released? If it is staged in a different repository (e.g., a snapshot or staging repo), please document the required repository configuration. Otherwise, it would help to
  either publish the artifact or remove the upgrade suggestion.

  Thanks for maintaining this library!
